description: session-hub-scope-guard: in a child session, blocks file writes outside the scope root

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scope-guard.mjs" || { rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 2 ] && exit 2; [ "${SESSION_HUB_ROLE:-}" = child ] && [ "${SESSION_HUB_GUARDS:-on}" != off ] && { echo "[session-hub] Write blocked: the scope guard could not run (exit $rc)." >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0; }
